## Eigene Beispiele / Code

::: panel-tabset
## R

```r
model <- lm(y ~ x, data = df)
summary(model)
```

## Python

```python
import statsmodels.api as sm
model = sm.OLS(y, sm.add_constant(x)).fit()
print(model.summary())
```
:::
